column1: Pakistan: A Hard Country|2011|10|10|2011|8,8,7.5,8,7.5,8.5,6.5,9,7.5,8|Anatol Lieven|Institutional explanation of kinship, justice, patronage, religion and military power, supported by regional comparison rather than merely personalities. https://kclpure.kcl.ac.uk/portal/en/publications/pakistan-a-hard-country/ confirms 2011 and references; https://ils.iba.edu.pk/bib/46022 supplies contents. State resilience is an interpretive argument, not a guarantee of future stability. D=7.5 low confidence from contents/description: provincial differences add constraints, local political detail has lower direct fit. National political analysis triggers both thematic deductions; approximate endpoint 2011. No established V2/V6 from an analytical political position alone.

D=6.5 low-confidence description estimate: concrete artistic practices add knowledge, personal recollection is less systematic. T11 national cultural history; T12=0; approximate memoir endpoint 1993. Nostalgia reduces inferential confidence without itself establishing ideological capture.
